ui.dashboardIntro.zh: 接着上次的进度，让日语成为每天的小习惯。
ui.dashboardIntro.en: Pick up where you left off. Make Japanese a daily habit.

ui.resumeNote.en: Return to your last opened lesson

ui.startNote.zh: 也可以在下方选择正在学的教材

ui.snapshotNote.zh: 收藏生词、标记掌握，每一次复习都算数。
ui.snapshotNote.en: Save words and mark what you know as you study.

ui.moreUnits.zh: 更多课次 · 还有 {count} 个单元

ui.noPracticeNote.zh: 完成自测后，这里会显示你的成绩。
ui.noPracticeNote.en: Your results will appear here after you finish a test.

ui.search.en: Find a lesson or Japanese title

ui.speechUnavailable.zh: 此浏览器暂不支持日语朗读。
ui.speechUnavailable.en: Speech playback is unavailable in this browser.

ui.finishAll.zh: 请完成全部题目后提交。

ui.pending.en: This material has not been added yet.

ui.error.zh: 内容暂时无法加载，请重试或返回索引。
ui.error.en: This lesson could not be loaded. Retry or return to the index.

ui.imported.zh: 已合并导入的学习记录。

ui.invalidFile.zh: 文件格式不正确，请选择本站导出的学习记录。
ui.invalidFile.en: Choose a valid progress file exported from this site.

ui.localOnly.zh: 记录保存在当前浏览器。换设备前可以导出；新站不会自动读取旧站的记录。
ui.localOnly.en: Progress stays in this browser. Export it before changing devices. Records from the old site are not read automatically.

ui.storageError.zh: 浏览器暂时无法保存；本次仍可继续学习，请导出记录备份。
ui.storageError.en: Browser storage is unavailable. You can keep studying; export your progress to keep a backup.

ui.sourceNote.zh: 教材内容参考原复习站整理。释义与解析为学习辅助，请结合原书和课堂内容使用。
ui.sourceNote.en: Study material adapted from the original review site. Use the glosses and explanations alongside your textbook and classes.

ui.katakanaTest.zh: 根据句子填写片假名单词。
ui.katakanaTest.en: Complete each sentence with the katakana word.

ui.wordTest.zh: 选择与日语词语对应的意思。
ui.wordTest.en: Choose the meaning of the Japanese word.

ui.speechLoading.zh: 正在等待设备日语声音加载…

ui.speechNoJapanese.zh: 没有可用的日语声音。请检查系统日语语音包或浏览器支持情况；声音稍后加载时会自动更新。
ui.speechNoJapanese.en: No Japanese voices available. Check your system Japanese speech pack or browser support. Voices will update if they load later.

ui.speechUnsupported.zh: 此浏览器不支持设备朗读。请使用支持 Web Speech API 的浏览器。
ui.speechUnsupported.en: This browser does not support device speech. Use a browser with Web Speech API support.

ui.speechFailed.zh: 设备朗读失败，请重新点击朗读或选择其他声音。
ui.speechFailed.en: Device speech failed. Click again or choose another voice.

ui.speechStorageError.zh: 无法保存声音设置，本次页面仍可使用。
ui.speechStorageError.en: Voice preferences could not be saved. Speech is still available for this session.

ui.voicevoxDetect.zh: 检测 / 重新检测 VOICEVOX

ui.voicevoxUnavailable.zh: 未检测到可用的 VOICEVOX，设备语音仍可正常使用。
ui.voicevoxUnavailable.en: No usable VOICEVOX detected. Device speech remains available.

ui.voicevoxFallback.zh: 本次 VOICEVOX 不可用，已回退到设备声音。
ui.voicevoxFallback.en: VOICEVOX is unavailable this time. Using device voices.

ui.voicevoxPlaybackFailed.zh: VOICEVOX 连接或播放失败，请检查 Engine、浏览器本地网络权限，或切回设备声音后重试。
ui.voicevoxPlaybackFailed.en: VOICEVOX connection or playback failed. Check the Engine and browser local network permissions, or switch to device voices and try again.

ui.voicevoxLocalHint.zh: VOICEVOX 检测本机 127.0.0.1:50021；手机上的此地址指向手机自身。
ui.voicevoxLocalHint.en: VOICEVOX checks this device at 127.0.0.1:50021. On a phone, this address refers to the phone itself.

ui.speechRoleHint.zh: “我”的声音跨课程共享，其他角色按课次保存；未配置或不可用时使用页面默认声音。
ui.speechRoleHint.en: The “我” voice is shared across lessons. Other roles are saved per lesson. Missing voices use the page default.

ui.storageRecovered.zh: 发现损坏的学习记录，已恢复可读取的条目。原始记录会保留为恢复备份，可在设置中导出。
ui.storageRecovered.en: Some saved progress is damaged. Readable records have been recovered; the original is kept as a recovery backup and can be exported in Settings.

ui.draftStorageError.zh: 浏览器无法保存测验草稿，请在离开前完成测验。
ui.draftStorageError.en: The browser cannot save this draft. Finish the test before leaving the page.

ui.retryPractice.zh: 错题重练（不会覆盖完整测验成绩）

ui.draftRestored.zh: 已恢复上次未完成的测验。
ui.draftRestored.en: Your unfinished test has been restored.
